App Lock

Protect Health Loksewa and your personal study information.

App Lock

When enabled, authentication is required to open Health Loksewa.

Unlock Method

Lock Automatically

Lock When App Is Minimized

Biometric unlock uses your device's own secure fingerprint/face system (WebAuthn) — Health Loksewa never sees or stores your biometric data, only whether your device confirmed it was you. Your PIN is stored as a one-way hash on this device, the same standard already used for locking individual Notes.

Nepal Income Tax Calculator

Estimate only, not official. Tax slabs and deduction limits are stored in a Sheet you control, not hardcoded — because Nepal's tax rules change every fiscal year via the Finance Act. This calculator applies whatever is currently in that Sheet. For anything filing-related, confirm against ird.gov.np or a tax professional.

Child Growth Screening

Screens for Stunting (height-for-age), Wasting (weight-for-height), and Underweight (weight-for-age) using the percent-of-median method against WHO reference medians. This is a screening estimate, not a diagnosis — a child flagged here should be assessed against full WHO growth charts by a health worker.

Indicator Calculator
IMR

CBR

← Back
IMR (Infant Mortality Rate)

Number of infant deaths (before age 1) per 1,000 live births in a year — a key indicator of a population's overall health and healthcare access.

← Back
MMR (Maternal Mortality Ratio)

Number of maternal deaths (from pregnancy or childbirth causes) per 100,000 live births — reflects the safety of maternal healthcare in a population.

← Back
Case Fatality Rate

Percentage of people diagnosed with a disease who die from it — measures how deadly a disease is among those who get it.

← Back
Attack Rate

Proportion of a population that develops a disease during an outbreak or defined time period — used to measure how contagious an outbreak is.

← Back
Crude Birth Rate

Total live births per 1,000 population in a year — a simple measure of fertility in a population, not adjusted for age or sex structure.

← Back
Crude Death Rate

Total deaths per 1,000 population in a year — a simple measure of overall mortality, not adjusted for age structure.

← Back
Neonatal Mortality Rate

Number of deaths in the first 28 days of life per 1,000 live births — reflects the quality of care around birth and the newborn period.

← Back
Under-5 Mortality Rate

Percentage of children who die before their 5th birthday, per 1,000 live births — a broad indicator of child health and survival in a population.

Pension & Savings Tools

Estimate only, not official. This uses the standard accrual formula for Nepal's pre-2076 (Legacy) civil service pension scheme. It does not account for caps, dearness allowance adjustments, or scheme-specific rules that may apply to you. For your actual pension amount, confirm with the Pension Management Office (pension.gov.np). This tool does not cover the Contributory Pension scheme (for those appointed after Shrawan 1, 2076) or the private-sector SSF scheme, which use different calculations entirely.

Legacy Government Pension (pre-2076 appointees)

SSF Contribution Calculator

Nepal's Social Security Fund — Employee 11% + Employer 20% = 31% of basic salary. Calculated on basic salary only (allowances excluded). Per Social Security Act 2074 & Regulations 2075.

SIP Calculator

Estimate the future value of a monthly Systematic Investment Plan.
